newForms.name: Bellowswell
newForms.lore: Its hum makes the whole cove sway; fisherfolk time their nets to it.

newForms.name: Bellowtide
newForms.lore: Breaches once a day, right on schedule; the wake it leaves reaches the far shore.

newForms.name: Bellowchorus
newForms.lore: Sings in two voices at once and has never heard itself the same way twice.

newForms.name: Bellowsong
newForms.lore: The oldest lakes remember its first note, and have been humming along ever since.

newForms.name: Barbelguard
newForms.lore: Adds a new armoured plate every season and remembers exactly where each old dent came from.

newForms.name: Barbelbulwark
newForms.lore: Wedges itself in river mouths and simply refuses to be moved by anything, including floods.

newForms.name: Barbelrampart
newForms.lore: Its scutes have started fusing at the seams; riverboats detour around it out of respect.

newForms.name: Barbelcitadel
newForms.lore: A living breakwater. Whole schools of smaller Mystics shelter behind it during storms.

newForms.name: Cinderspine
newForms.lore: Its spines glow brighter with every meal of lava-moss; approach from upwind.

newForms.name: Scorchspine
newForms.lore: Leaves a trail of scorched bubbles wherever it swims, gone before anyone can ask why.

newForms.name: Blazespine
newForms.lore: Flares every spine at once when startled; the lake briefly looks like a sunset.

newForms.name: Novaspine
newForms.lore: A single flare from its full crown of spines can light the deepest lava-cave to noon.

newForms.name: Cloudsail
newForms.lore: Glides just above the water until something spooks it, then it glides just above the clouds.

newForms.name: Galesail
newForms.lore: Rides the thermals over Stormreach for fun, and lands only because dinner is on the lake.

newForms.name: Zephyrsail
newForms.lore: Can hang motionless in a headwind for an hour, just to see who gets bored first.

newForms.name: Stratosail
newForms.lore: Crosses the whole Sapphire Coast on a single gust, arriving before the wind does.

newForms.name: Galeharbinger
newForms.lore: Arrives before every storm on the Crown, and the storm has learned to wait for it.

newForms.name: Galesentinel
newForms.lore: Circles the highest ruins at dawn, counting every Mystic that made it through the night.

newForms.name: Galecrown
newForms.lore: Wears the wind itself like a crown; the old Sky Wardens are said to have followed it up first.

newForms.name: Tidefox
newForms.lore: Times its hunts to the tide table better than the harbourmaster does.

newForms.name: Brinefox
newForms.lore: Its coat sheds seawater in a perfect arc; sailors call it good luck to get splashed.

newForms.name: Ripfox
newForms.lore: Cuts across rip currents like they are footpaths, because to it, they are.

newForms.name: Maelfox
newForms.lore: Where three currents meet, look for the fox. It has been swimming the knot for years.

newForms.name: Reefbastion
newForms.lore: A second reef has started growing on the first; smaller Mystics have opinions about the rent.

newForms.name: Reefmonarch
newForms.lore: The oldest fish in the lake nest in its shell and never once ask permission.

newForms.name: Reefmonolith
newForms.lore: Barely moves once a decade, and when it does, the whole coastline gets a new tide pool.

newForms.name: Coralshell
newForms.lore: New coral buds on its shell every tide; it wears a different reef every season.

newForms.name: Coralcrest
newForms.lore: Waves its brightest claw first in every fight, mostly because it is very proud of it.

newForms.name: Coralcrown
newForms.lore: A whole cleaning-shrimp colony rides its shell rent-free, and everyone seems fine with that.

newForms.name: Coralthrone
newForms.lore: Settles in one tide pool for good and lets the reef simply build up and around it.

prompts.name: Bellowdeep
prompts.prompt: A colossal, gentle blue-grey whale with a broad barrel body, small fin-like flippers and deep-set warm amber eyes half-closed in song, smooth rounded silhouette with faint darker speckling along its back.

prompts.name: Bellowswell
prompts.prompt: A slightly larger Bellowdeep with a fuller belly and softly glowing pale-blue throat grooves that pulse when it hums, same rounded silhouette and amber eyes, now ringed with faint freckled patterning.

prompts.name: Bellowtide
prompts.prompt: Broader still, its back now carries a low ridge of barnacle-like nodules glowing faintly blue at the tips, the throat grooves deepened into visible channels, tail fluke grown a soft frilled edge.

prompts.name: Bellowchorus
prompts.prompt: A truly massive whale-shape with twin rows of luminous throat grooves shimmering like organ pipes, dark ocean-blue skin fading to cream underneath, small crystalline barnacle-crowns forming along its spine.

prompts.name: Bellowsong
prompts.prompt: An ancient, legendary-scale leviathan whose entire back is a crown of glowing coral-blue ridges pulsing in rhythm with its song, deep indigo skin, a cream underside, huge kind amber eyes holding the whole lake's memory.

prompts.name: Barbelmail
prompts.prompt: A stout armoured catfish standing on four stubby legs, its back plated in overlapping bronze-brown scutes and long whiskered barbels framing a wide, patient face.

prompts.name: Barbelguard
prompts.prompt: A broader Barbelmail with an extra row of plating along its flanks and thicker barbels, the same bronze-brown scutes now showing faint hammered, rivet-like ridges.

prompts.name: Barbelbulwark
prompts.prompt: Heavier-set with a raised plated crest along its spine and stouter legs, its scutes darkened toward iron-brown, barbels grown stiff and spear-like.

prompts.name: Barbelrampart
prompts.prompt: A wall of a creature: broad, low and dense, its plating now overlapping like castle brick in deep rust-brown, small tremor-cracks of pale ore glinting between the scutes.

prompts.name: Barbelcitadel
prompts.prompt: A living fortress of dark iron-brown armour plate crowned with jagged rampart-like ridges along its back, four thick braced legs, long barbels hanging like drawbridge chains.

prompts.name: Emberspine
prompts.prompt: A sleek fire lionfish standing on fin-legs, its body striped in glowing orange-red with a crown of ember-tipped spines fanned along its back.

prompts.name: Cinderspine
prompts.prompt: A larger, more muscular Emberspine with denser spine-fans that smoulder at the tips, deeper orange-red stripes and small trailing wisps of smoke.

prompts.name: Scorchspine
prompts.prompt: Its spine-fan has doubled, curving forward like a blazing mane, skin darkening toward scorched red-black with bright cinder-orange stripes still glowing beneath.

prompts.name: Blazespine
prompts.prompt: A towering fire fish whose entire dorsal fan burns steady like banked coals, deep garnet-red body with molten orange fissure-markings and trailing smoke plumes.

prompts.name: Novaspine
prompts.prompt: A radiant, majestic final form whose full crown of spines flares like a captured sunburst, near-black ember-red body glowing from every seam, bright golden-white nova-glow at its spine-tips.

prompts.name: Skysail
prompts.prompt: A small manta-ray-shaped glider skimming just above water, pale sky-blue with a soft frilled wing-edge and two round curious eyes.

prompts.name: Cloudsail
prompts.prompt: A slightly larger Skysail with longer, more sculpted wing-tips and a faint teal sheen, its frilled edges now trailing small wisps like cloud vapour.

prompts.name: Galesail
prompts.prompt: Broader-winged, banking through the air rather than water, its pale-blue body deepening to teal with pale cloud-streak patterning across its back.

prompts.name: Zephyrsail
prompts.prompt: A graceful high-altitude glider with long trailing wing-streamers and a deep teal-cyan body, faint wind-glow tracing the edges of its wings.

prompts.name: Stratosail
prompts.prompt: A majestic sky-manta with vast sculpted wings edged in glowing pale cyan, deep storm-teal body fading to cream beneath, trailing long wind-streamer ribbons like a comet's tail.

prompts.name: Skimgull
prompts.prompt: A scrappy pale pigeon-like Mystic with quick wings and bright curious eyes, feathers a soft off-white with grey wingtips.

prompts.name: Galeherald
prompts.prompt: A larger, gilded gull with a fuller crest of gold-cream feathers streaming from its head, warm amber-gold plumage and sharper, more confident eyes.

prompts.name: Galeharbinger
prompts.prompt: A tall, regal herald-bird with a longer golden mane-crest and broader wings edged in pale storm-white, plumage deepened to a rich honey-gold.

prompts.name: Galesentinel
prompts.prompt: A commanding sky-sentinel with an even fuller crest streaming like a banner, deep gold plumage with pale cloud-white wing markings and sharp, watchful eyes.

prompts.name: Galecrown
prompts.prompt: A majestic, near-mythic herald crowned in a blazing mane of gold-white feathers, rich amber-gold body, vast wings edged in glowing pale light, radiating quiet authority.

prompts.name: Saltfox
prompts.prompt: A lean coastal fox with a pale blue-white coat, webbed paw-tufts and a fin-like tail tip, alert and quick-eyed.

prompts.name: Tidefox
prompts.prompt: A slightly larger Saltfox with a deeper blue-tinged coat and small translucent fin-frills along its tail and ears.

prompts.name: Brinefox
prompts.prompt: A sleeker, faster fox with a rich teal-blue coat, more pronounced fin-frills down its spine and a glossy salt-crystal sheen catching the light.

prompts.name: Ripfox
prompts.prompt: A swift, wave-carved fox shape with a deep aqua coat streaked in foam-white, fully finned tail and ear-tufts, built for cutting through current.

prompts.name: Maelfox
prompts.prompt: A majestic final-form fox wreathed in trailing fin-like fur that moves like flowing water, deep ocean-blue coat with foam-white markings and piercing storm-grey eyes.

prompts.name: Shellback
prompts.prompt: A squat hermit-toad wearing a borrowed shell far too big for it, warm teal skin and a curious, sleepy expression peeking out.

prompts.name: Reefwarden
prompts.prompt: A larger shelled toad whose shell has become a living coral reef, barnacles, sea fans and glowing coral tips, teal-blue skin fading to a cream belly, huge warm amber eyes.

prompts.name: Reefbastion
prompts.prompt: An even broader reef-toad, its shell now a dense coral rampart with small glowing tide-pools between the ridges, deeper teal skin and a thicker, more armoured brow.

prompts.name: Reefmonarch
prompts.prompt: A grand reef-guardian whose coral shell has grown tiered like a crown of reef terraces, rich blue-teal skin, glowing coral crests, and a calm, regal gaze.

prompts.name: Reefmonolith
prompts.prompt: An ancient, colossal reef-guardian whose shell is an entire miniature reef ecosystem of glowing coral spires, tiny waterfalls and drifting fronds, deep teal-blue skin and vast, kind amber eyes.

prompts.name: Coralclack
prompts.prompt: A bright coral-pink crab with a coral-garden growing across its shell, one larger display claw and quick, clacking motions.

prompts.name: Coralshell
prompts.prompt: A slightly larger Coralclack with denser coral growth across its shell and a brighter, more elaborate display claw fringed in pale pink fans.

prompts.name: Coralcrest
prompts.prompt: A broader crab whose coral crown has grown taller along its shell-ridge, deep coral-red colouring with pale pink fan accents and a proudly raised display claw.

prompts.name: Coralcrown
prompts.prompt: A striking coral-armoured crab whose shell now forms a tiered coral crown, rich rose-red colouring, glowing pale-pink coral tips and an imposing raised claw.

prompts.name: Coralthrone
prompts.prompt: A magnificent, throne-like crab whose entire shell has become a flourishing coral garden with glowing fronds and tiny anemones, deep rose-red body and a regal, unhurried presence.
